why: On November 26, 2026, the Bank of England's Financial Policy Committee published its November Financial Stability Report, warning that circular, opaque AI financing—with 2026 hyperscaler bond issuance topping $305 billion and total exposures exceeding $4 trillion—raises contagion risk while AI agents and open-weight models with removable safeguards heighten cyber threats. Backed by the complete primary text and broad financial and tech coverage including Reuters, this UK warning is new to the blog.

set_aside.why: Tencent's Nature paper is paywalled beyond its abstract, all peptide results are preclinical mouse trials, and independent press coverage outside niche outlets remains narrow.
OpenAI's cited undated Help Center page omits the December shared-limit merger and still describes separate Chat and Work toggles, while testing covers few Pro users.
